b7ba16.title: Initial target map for /workspace/amp
b7ba16.content:
- **Assessment mode:** White-box local codebase with expected dynamic validation.
- **Stack observed so far:** `React` + `Vite` frontend, `Express` backend in `server.ts`, TypeScript throughout.
- **API surface observed from entrypoint:** `GET /api/health`, `POST /api/verify-office-order`, plus SPA catch-all.
- **UI feature areas from `src/components/`:** `auth`, `applicant`, `admin`, `workflow`, `requisition`, `helpdesk`, `dashboard`, and several form/modal flows.
- **High-value themes to validate next:** authentication/role enforcement, client-side state or storage trust, office-order upload/verification abuse, business-logic flaws in approval/requisition flows, and any admin-only functionality reachable without server-side checks.
